lines: Michael Mayer's role has shrunk lately: he saw 3.3 targets per game over the last 3 games, down from 4.8 on the season.
He still plays most snaps, 75% over the last 3 games, but has had 0.0 red zone carries plus targets per game in that span.
Week 12 is at CLE, who allow the 11th-most PPR points per game to tight ends, though LV's implied team total is only 18.5 points.
